description.description: A world map showing the linear trend in annual surface air temperature from 1995 to 2024. The map uses a color scale ranging from dark blue (cooling) to dark red (warming), indicating changes in degrees Celsius per decade. Most of the globe is covered in shades of orange and red, indicating a general warming trend particularly in the Arctic, while a few small areas in the oceans show slight cooling in light blue.
